reason: I buy fixtures from Wayfair, Lowe's or West Elm because I know how returns and delivery work there, and I've never heard of Nora Furnish. A big fixture shipped back on my dime if I change my mind is a gamble I don't need to take with a whole house to light.
objection: Return shipping on a big fixture would cost me a fortune, and I have no idea if this company will still answer the phone if something arrives cracked or wrong.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns (or a prepaid label) on the first order, plus a sample or reviews from other designers or hosts I can check.
